identity.philosophy: Deep contrast, architectural precision, trustworthy minimalism

font_family.heading: Space Grotesk, sans-serif
font_family.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

layout.grid_system: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 h-screen w-full overflow-hidden
layout.container: flex flex-col justify-center px-8 sm:px-12 lg:px-24 xl:px-32 py-12 h-full relative z-10
layout.visual_panel: hidden lg:flex flex-col justify-between p-12 relative bg-slate-900 h-full w-full

input.base: h-12 bg-slate-900/50 border-slate-800 text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-500 focus:border-green-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-500 transition-all duration-200
input.label: text-sm font-medium text-slate-300 mb-2 block

button.primary: h-12 w-full bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 text-white font-semibold rounded-md shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,197,94,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(34,197,94,0.5)] transition-all duration-300 transform hover:-translate-y-0.5
button.secondary: h-12 w-full bg-transparent border border-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white transition-colors

visual_enhancers.gradient_overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-slate-950 via-slate-950/50 to-transparent opacity-80
visual_enhancers.noise_texture: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)' opacity='0.05'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")

login.heading: Welcome back
login.subheading: Enter your credentials to access your workspace.
login.visual_text: Building the future of Nordic enterprise.

register.heading: Create an account
register.visual_subtext: Streamline your operations with our all-in-one platform.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Split Screen' layout for both Login and Register pages.
Use the provided architectural image for the right-hand panel (on desktop).
Ensure the 'noise_texture' is applied as a subtle overlay on the dark background to prevent banding.
Use 'Space Grotesk' for the main headings (Welcome back / Create account).
Input fields must have 'h-12' for better touch targets and a premium feel.
The primary button should have a 'glow' effect using shadow-green-500/30.
Include a 'Go back' or 'Home' link at the top left for better navigation.
Use 'sonner' for all form success/error notifications.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'login-email-input', 'submit-button').
Maintain the Dark Mode default. Do not implement a light mode toggle for these specific pages unless global layout demands it.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays are mandatory.
All interactive elements MUST include 'data-testid' attribute.
